rows.coder_note: Reference 7 (Sun 2023, DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6) has four dictionary rows and the attribution sentence (p001) carries no attribute that separates them. The only separating attribute, 'solely on the European population', is in p003, a Discussion sentence in a passage with no linked reference, so rule E is not met. The Synapse identifier syn51364943 (p002) is the UKB-PPP project deposit, which holds several of the releases and names none; no sample size is given.
